result.topic_en: A pencil draft of a letter by Riemann, dated 2 July 1857, to a professor. It concerns a request passed on by Dr. Dedekind for the announcement of Riemann's lectures for the next semester, and reports that his treatise on Abelian transcendents has been sent to Dr. Borchardt. It is written on the back of a printed 'Frachtkarte No. 2' form, which appears upside down at the bottom.
result.transcription:
Hochgeehrtester Herr Professor!

[-...-]

[-...-] [-...-] [-...-]

nicht sofort [-eine-] Ankündigung meiner Vorlesungen für das nächste Semester einsende,

nächsten Tagen noch mündlich Ihren Rath darüber erbitten zu können.

[-... ... ...-] [?]
in dankbarster Gesinnung

Quickborn [?], d. 2 Juli

Ihr ergebenster Schüler
B. Riemann
